Subject: Pilot credits & pricing — Acme / Redwood pilot

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today — great to hear more about the search-relevance pilot and where you want to measure uplift. I wanted to recap the key next steps and a few qualification items we didn't fully lock down on the call so we can size the pilot correctly:

- Pilot scope: 2 week evaluation across the web-search query reranking pipeline (server-side, batch + streaming inference).
- Current estimate you mentioned: ~120M tokens/user-month for the reranker if you include embeddings + generation requests at peak (note: that’s a wide estimate we can refine).
- Target unit economics: you mentioned being comfortable with a ballpark of $120–$160 per 1M tokens for a production-priced model; for the pilot you said you were looking for something closer to $0 (credits) or a deeply discounted trial to validate quality.

Questions/asks:
1) Can you confirm expected token burn over the 2-week pilot (rough weekly estimate or example day)?
2) Do you have an internal budget range for a short POC if credits don't fully cover run rate? (even a rough $/month helps us size approvals)
3) Any compliance or IP constraints we should flag for team access or logs?

On our side I can request a pilot credit extension — typically we start with 500k–1M tokens of free credits for a narrow test; if your projected burn is higher we can submit an exception to the credit committee. If you can confirm the expected burn we’ll route the approval today.

Next steps: if you can reply with the three items above I’ll loop in Ben (Sales Manager) and Dev (Solutions Eng) to request credits & confirm config (batching, KV cache, quantization profile) so we don’t get surprised on cost.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below:

- Expected burn: based on our telemetry, rough estimate is ~300k tokens/day at peak for the reranker plus ~50k tokens/day for embeddings => ~350k/day. For a 14 day pilot that’s ~5M tokens total. We expect the first 3 days to be lower as we ramp.
- Budget: for a POC we can stretch to ~$2k–$3k for the window but would prefer credits to cover the bulk of it while we validate.
- Compliance: standard NDA in place, no special IP constraints. We will want logs retained for 30 days and proof of SOC2 controls (we have your SOC2 doc already).

If you can provide 1M credits up front and we can increase if the ramp looks good, that would be ideal. Also please confirm the model variant you'll route to for the pilot and the expected latency / suggested batch sizes.

Alex

Ben / Dev — looping you in to request a pilot credit exception. Acme (Alex) estimated ~5M tokens for a 2-week pilot (350k/day peak). They have a small POC budget ($2k–$3k) but prefer credits to cover initial run. Requesting: 1M free token credits now and ability to top up quickly if usage ramps to match their estimate.

Key constraints: 30d log retention (standard), SOC2 ok. Please advise on the suggested model routing and any quick config knobs we should recommend to reduce spend (e.g., batching, prefix KV cache, quantization profile).

Alex also asked for target unit economics (/1M tokens) for production pricing — they mentioned $120–$160. If we share a production reference price, keep it clear that pilot credits are one-off and production pricing will differ by committed volume.

Marissa

Quick technical note:
- Suggested pilot model: rwi-llama2-13b-optimized (balanced latency/cost). Expect ~45–70ms p50 on our dedicated inference nodes with a batch size of 4 for sampling; throughput scales with longer sequences.
- Cost reduction levers: enable prefix/KV cache for repeated query patterns, enable small-batch streaming for latency-critical calls, and use 8-bit quantization profile if they can accept slight perf tradeoffs. These typically reduce token costs by ~20–35% vs naive streaming.
- For a 5M token pilot I recommend approving 1M credits up-front + a manual top-up path to avoid a hard stop (we can monitor burn and authorize another 2M if needed).

I'll prepare a short config checklist to share with Alex (batching config, max tokens per call, cache keying) — want to keep pilot narrow to reranker endpoints only to control burn.
